desc: Fuel your adventures any time, any place with Nature Valley Protein French Vanilla Granola, flavored with other natural flavors. The taste of French vanilla and the goodness of granola made with whole grain oats are a wholesome way to kick-start your day. Each 2/3 cup serving provides 13g of protein and energy from 33g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), plus a good source of fiber (7g of total fat per 2/3 cup serving). Plus, the crunchy oats and French vanilla flavored granola clusters have no artificial flavors or colors, and no high fructose corn syrup. So whether you enjoy a bowlful as a breakfast cereal or take along the pouch for family snacks on the run, this granola delivers on the go energy. Add your own fruit and nut combination for DIY trail mix. Sprinkle the Nature Valley granola clusters over a yogurt parfait or acai bowl for serious crunch. This pouch of loose granola cereal is resealable for easy school snacks or part of breakfast on the go. At Nature Valley, we believe that what you put in is what you get out. So wherever the moment takes you and your family, you can rely on our great-tasting snacks to help keep you going, whenever and wherever you need it. Contains one plastic pouch of crunchy Nature Valley Protein Granola, French Vanilla Granola, 11 oz; perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals.
features:

WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS: Granola with no artificial flavors or colors, and no high fructose corn syrup, for the quality you'd expect from Nature Valley snacks

PART OF BREAKFAST OR SNACK: Enjoy as a crunchy topping over a yogurt parfait or in an acai bowl, pour a bowl with milk for a breakfast addition, or take along for on the go snacks; An ideal pantry staple

ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Soy Protein Isolate, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Tapioca Syrup, Molasses, Rice Starch, Soy Lecithin, Baking Soda, Salt, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness.
